source.title: Fermanagh Herald, 21 May 1949, p. 3 ("Four contests in Fermanagh")
source.publisher: Fermanagh Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Original citation restored 6 Nov 2026 (the 5 Nov verification had moved it because of a text-cleaning fault).

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Irvinestown rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Garrison was the only contested division; the Fermanagh Herald prints the other nominations, showing one change of member. Returned unopposed.
